description: Retrieve details for multiple papers in a single request (up to 500). More efficient than calling paper_get repeatedly. Pass a list of paper IDs in any supported format.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, overriding defaults. Paper fields: paperId, title, abstract, authors, year, citationCount, referenceCount, influentialCitationCount, isOpenAccess, openAccessPdf, fieldsOfStudy, externalIds, url, venue, publicationVenue, publicationTypes, publicationDate, journal, citations, references. Author fields: authorId, name, affiliations, homepage, paperCount, citationCount, hIndex.

paper_ids.description: List of paper IDs to retrieve (1-500). Supports all ID formats.

items.description: Paper identifier. Accepts: bare S2 Paper ID (40-char hash), DOI:10.xxxx/xxxx, ARXIV:xxxx.xxxx, PMID:nnnnn, PMCID:PMCnnnnn, MAG:nnnnn, ACL:xxx, CorpusId:nnnnn

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable text (default), 'json' for raw structured data

name: paper_batch
